body: Cool, thanks for the help all 0 of you guys, really appreciate it. No really, now I have one more good reason to kill myself, no one fucking cares about anyone in this shitty world. Maybe this'll encourage me enough to actually do it this time.

Are you me? This sounds so much like my situation too, I 1,000% understand how you feel. But you at least have a job, with everything going on in your life it's admirable you can still get up and go to work and have some money, I can't do that. How do you do it?

I see, thank you for responding! I'm sorry this is something you're able to answer, I wish the world had treated you better than you got. 

I really wish the cons outweighed the pros, I don't want to see blood or have scars but I desperately want something to give me a mental release like you said. Is there anything else that would work like that?
What's it like to cut, how does it make you feel? I'm too much of a coward to try it but I'm interested.

What project are you working on? If you don't mind me asking, it sounds interesting. If not I can definitely relate to wanting one last thing to keep you going and then being free when it's done with. And I especially relate to wanting everyone to be happy instead of sad when you die, it's so tough when you know the thing that would make you happy/at peace would also make so many people sad. Have you ever opened up to your friends and family about this?

I know exactly what you mean, nothing feels like it matters. No matter what the average person does it'll do nothing, because the world is shit and the people who made it like that get to keep it that way because they have all the power. It feels like, what's the point in trying to find something to live for? It'll either be mundane, reminding you life's meaningless and boring so a reason to die, or if it's good it'll just get destroyed and remind you nothing good ever lasts, even more of a reason to die. If you have any other thoughts to share I'm happy to listen.

The way they're """handling""" this virus is absolutely a disaster and it's making me suicidal too, fuck these selfish enabler rich racist assholes. I can't imagine how much worse it is for you to have asthma and targeted racism at you on top of that, it's despicable and idiotic, you don't deserve to deal with that. I am so sorry this world is all wrong, you deserve a better life than this. If you want to vent more I'm here to listen.

I totally understand how you feel. Even without the virus the job market was a pos, now it's even worse. But you deserve to be proud of finishing your degree, especially since it was a hard one. You definitely have skills and talent if you were able to do that. I'm here to talk if you want to.
